title: Finite constant module maps are locally linear on slices
statement: Let (C,J) be a small site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], B a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], M a finite B-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module], and N any B-module. For the constant module functor F [def-weil-pbc-strict-perfect-coefficient-package], every morphism a:F(M)|U→F(N)|U becomes F(g)|V for some B-linear g:M→N on every member V→U of a covering sieve; restriction uses the canonical successive-restriction isomorphisms [def-pur-localized-ringed-site].

source.place: Tag 093U, lemma-kernel-finite-locally-constant (3), finite constant module maps are locally linear on slices

proof.text: Over a Noetherian ring every finitely generated module is finitely presented. The constant module functor used here is definitionally the module-sheafification functor of the existing local-Hom theorem.
View the morphism on C/U as a section of the local Hom presheaf. Local surjectivity of the constant-Hom comparison provides a covering image sieve and a coefficient-module map on each member.

Apply the local-Hom equivalence to the image-sieve witness. Its restriction formula is the composite through the successive-restriction isomorphisms, yielding exactly the asserted equality. No nonempty-cover or nondegeneracy assumption is used.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_cover_constant_linearMap (M N : ModuleCat.{u} B) [Module.Finite B M] (U : C)
    (a : ((strictPerfectConstantSheaf J B).obj M).over U ⟶
      ((strictPerfectConstantSheaf J B).obj N).over U) :
    ∃ S ∈ J U, ∀ (V : C) (f : V ⟶ U), S f → ∃ g : M ⟶ N,
      (overFunctorMap _ f).inv.app ((strictPerfectConstantSheaf J B).obj M) ≫
        (overMap _ f).map a ≫
        (overFunctorMap _ f).hom.app ((strictPerfectConstantSheaf J B).obj N) =
          ((strictPerfectConstantSheaf J B).map g).over V
